body:
On the back: “late Wednesday, emerald flecks in the cab after the crop trial. the chickens stopped moving in the yard.”

The flecks were still on the seat the next morning.
title: Annotated photograph

body: The driver said the animals had to wait while the officials finished counting cars. He asked whether the trailer counted as one vehicle or several lives. They copied the plate against a list and waved the empty truck ahead.
title: Notebook page
